name: mastra-host
title: Mastra Host

origin.source: Real @mastra/core (not a shim): createTool from @mastra/core/tools + Agent from @mastra/core/agent calling runAgent, with an in-memory snapshot store keyed by handle

comparison.purpose: The Mastra LLM agent gets two tools bridging to the email-drafter machine: start_workflow runs runAgent to idle/done and returns a JSON-safe handle + the machine's typed interaction; resume_workflow reloads the persisted snapshot and delivers the human's event. The machine owns legality; the agent converses.
